free_tier.stated: 100% free with ads; unlimited storage as long as each file does not exceed 50GB; files remain available for 30 days of inactivity.
free_tier.notes: The FAQ states no upload or download speed limits.

per_object_cap.stated: Each file can be up to 50GB in size.

retention.stated: Files remain available for 30 days of inactivity. If a file is accessed within that period, the timer resets.
retention.notes: Expired or deleted files cannot be recovered.

egress.terms: No speed limits on uploads or downloads; no byte cap printed.

interface_detail: The FAQ says developers can use an API to integrate upload and management; the API documentation page was not read.
tooling: API stated on the FAQ; the API page was not read.
chaining: 50 GB per file with no sign-up and a 30-day inactivity timer that resets on access.

limits.value: 30 days of inactivity; access resets the timer

binding_note: No byte cap is printed, so the 30-day inactivity window is the first thing a stored file meets.

identity_cost.detail: The homepage says 'Share large files effortlessly—up to 50GB per file, no sign-up needed.'

reliability_note: The pricing page states paid plans accept crypto payments only; no plan price was readable.
confidence_note: Homepage FAQ and pricing FAQ read on 2026-11-03. Paid plan prices unverified: the pricing page showed only a FAQ.
